errors.evidence: The left pie chart's smaller segment is described as '浅蓝色' (light blue), but the image shows it as a darker blue.
The right pie chart's larger segment is described as '浅橙色' (light orange), but the image shows it as a darker orange.
The right pie chart's smaller segment is described as '浅绿色' (light green), but the image shows it as a standard green.
The description mentions '上下两条灰色直线' (two gray lines), but the image only shows a single gray connecting line.
The description omits mentioning that the yellow color in the main pie chart is not represented in the legend.

The description does not explicitly state the purpose of the chart: to illustrate the compositional characteristics of the 'an' structure in terms of adjective-noun combinations and the visibility of the '的' character.
